record.file_problem: Repository metadata, README, and file list only; code and result files were not read or run.
record.tranche_reason: The README describes the project as a recreation of the original paper, says it conducts two experiments presented there, and reports outcomes for them.
record.gate_note: The README reports qualitative refusal-score outcomes for weight orthogonalisation and activation addition. It describes the KL-score criterion used to choose a vector, but gives no result for that criterion; selection criteria are not recorded as rows.
record.test_reason: A replication of the original paper on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. It uses the same difference-in-means extraction and the same refusal-metric proxy, and reports before/after refusal-score outcomes for weight orthogonalisation on harmful prompts and source-layer activation addition on harmless prompts.
record.authors_conclusion: The record's paraphrase is accurate. The README presents the project as recreating the original: a difference-in-means direction is extracted, weight orthogonalisation with it removes refusal on harmful prompts, and adding it at the source layer induces refusal on harmless prompts in Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct.
record.recipe_differences: The README says it is a recreation and follows a similar extraction method, using the paper's refusal metric. Removal is reported as weight orthogonalisation and addition at the source layer; the README does not report the original all-layer, all-position projection intervention. This is a replication project, not a report of code execution verified by this reader.
record.problems: The README gives qualitative score directions but no numerical outcomes or uncertainty. It reports only one model. It does not report a general-capability evaluation; the KL-score appears as a vector-selection criterion, not a reported outcome.
record.rows_left_out: No result rows omitted. The README mentions response samples in results/validation_results.json, but the file was not read; no further results are inferred from its presence in the file list.

untested.parts: No general-capability evaluation; the KL-score < 0.1 is only a direction-selection criterion, not a reported outcome. No generation-based refusal or safety scores. Only one model.
Only one released model (Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct). No check of whether capabilities are kept after the weight edit. No generation-judged refusal rate.

missing.what: Numerical before/after refusal-score values, likely plotted in the result figures, and response samples that could give an actual refusal rate.

record.verdict_notes: This is an unreviewed GitHub replication with 0 stars. Evidence is limited to qualitative README statements about the sign of a log-odds proxy. No uncertainty, controls, random-direction baseline or capability evaluation are reported. The selection criteria (bypass-score, induced-score, KL-score, layer cutoff) are correctly kept out of the rows.

versions.untested_parts: Does not report projecting the direction out of every layer and position; removal is by weight orthogonalisation, and addition is at the source layer. Does not report a general-capability evaluation.
Only Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct is reported; no broader set of released models is tested.
No test of attacks suppressing the direction or training against its ablation.
No comparison of single-direction, affine, cone, or multiple-direction accounts.
No separation of harmfulness judgment from refusal decision.
No transfer across languages, model variants, or base-to-instruct models.
No comparison of refusal-training methods or training stages.
